build_dataset_builder: build a tfds BeamBasedBuilder that downloads UserLibri text data from Kaggle and generates per-book splits
read_metadata_file: read a tab-separated metadata file and return a dictionary mapping book IDs to their text example counts
generate_examples: generate text examples from a book training file yielding key-value pairs with text and book_id fields
create_split_generators: create tfds split generators from lm_data directory files grouped by book_id
build_dataset_info: build a tfds DatasetInfo with text and book_id features for the UserLibri language modeling dataset
